Join starting-XI strength onto WP features

Source: R/wp_structural.R
add_wp_xi_strength.Rd

Adds xi_diff = home XI strength minus away XI strength. A team's XI strength is 11 x the mean rating of its rated starters, each starter's rating taken from the latest as-of snapshot dated BEFORE match day (snapshot <= match_date - 1, at most roll_days old). Use a leak-free as-of rating such as career_panna_asof.parquet (each monthly snapshot fitted only on matches up to its date); the weekly PSR is NOT leak-free for model evaluation, because its coefficients are fitted on all seasons (panna#273, 2026-11-10). A team with fewer than min_rated rated starters gets NA, never 0.

Usage

add_wp_xi_strength(
  wp_features,
  lineups,
  ratings,
  roll_days = 62L,
  min_rated = 9L
)

Arguments

wp_features

Output of create_wp_features (needs match_id, team_id, is_home).

lineups

Lineups with match_id, team_id, player_id, match_date, is_starter.

ratings

As-of ratings: player_id, ref_date (or snapshot_date) and panna (or rating).

roll_days

Oldest snapshot accepted, in days (default 62: monthly snapshots).

min_rated

Fewest rated starters for a team value (default 9).

Value

wp_features as a data.table with xi_diff; attribute xi_table holds the per team-match values.
